description: Rust fence with distinctive identifier from ops/handlers

evidence.content:
the A1 macro expands #[op] into inventory entries:

```rust
#[op(cli = "recall", mcp = "rein_recall")]
pub fn recall(&self, query: &str) -> OpsResult<Vec<Memory>> {
    self.store.recall(query)
}
```

the macro also registers AuthPolicy for REST:

```rust
inventory::submit!(AuthPolicy::localhost_only("recall"));
```

description: Python fence for hook integration (Claude Code PostToolUse)

evidence.content:
hook invocation is configured in settings.json; rein hook post runs extraction async:

```python
def on_post_tool_use(event):
    subprocess.Popen(["rein", "hook", "post"], stdin=subprocess.PIPE).communicate(json.dumps(event).encode())
```

the stop hook creates Episode nodes from session summaries:

```python
def on_stop(session):
    summary = compile_summary(session)
    subprocess.run(["rein", "hook", "stop"], input=json.dumps(summary).encode())
```
